Ruled lines to the right of the gutter fold (x≈3195–3210) belong to the facing leaf. The faint stroke near x≈3490, y≈790 is also facing-leaf material and is excluded.
Binding thread nicks along the gutter and the scanner background are not text.
Context only: fol. 264 ends with a list of works marked 'cont. next page'. That list appears to resume on fol. 265, not on this blank verso. This does not create any record here.
unresolved_relationships: The function of the isolated '?' cannot be determined, and no attachment is asserted.
